title: AI Design Skills — Landing Page Design & Design to Motion
resourceType: Cross-Harness AI Design Skill Collection / Markdown SKILL.md
purpose: Elaya 維護的 AI 前端設計指令集，將 Landing Page 規劃、轉換導向文案與明確視覺規範，以及從靜態 Figma／UI 畫面重建高保真動態展示、輸出影片與 GIF 的操作流程，拆成兩個可獨立使用的 SKILL.md。
recommendation: 適合使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等 AI coding 工具時，希望用可複用規範產出 Landing Page 或將 UI 畫面製成動態產品展示的人；應先核對既有品牌、實際產品證據與可及性規範。
notes: Official README, two SKILL.md files, folder list and root LICENSE checked on 2026-10-26. Contains skills/landing-page-design/SKILL.md and skills/design-to-motion/SKILL.md; each folder currently contains only its SKILL.md, not executable scripts. Official installation examples copy rules into Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/Windsurf, but no tool was installed or run. Repository license: MIT, including permission for commercial use subject to preserving copyright and license notices in copies/substantial portions. landing-page-design includes prescriptive fonts/layout/motion constraints and recommends realistic sample numbers, names and testimonials: generated sample claims must not be represented as verified facts. design-to-motion describes optional Figma API access with a user credential, exported design assets, browser rendering and FFmpeg: privacy, local commands and dependencies require separate permission and review. No quality, conversion gains, export fidelity or security claims were independently tested.
features: 集合 Landing Page Design 與 Figma／Motion 相關設計 Skills。
以 Skills CLI 依需求安裝個別技能而不是全套。
提供可客製的設計流程、內容策略與視覺規範。
requirements: 先以 Skills CLI 列出可用 Skill，再選定目標 Host 與單一任務。
提供真實品牌、受眾、技術堆疊與可驗收的 UI 約束。
limitations: Skill 是指令集，不能保證產出可用於正式產品的設計或程式。
視覺結果仍需在實際畫面檢查可及性、響應式與字型授權。
